# ADR-0006: Three compartment sizes

**Status:** Proposed

**Date:** 2026-04-07

**Deciders:** Lockerline architect

> **Current state (banner, 2026-04-12). Read this before the body.** Sizes are
> measured by the locker at fill time, not chosen at reservation.

## Context

Parcels that do not fit are carried back to the depot.

## Decision

We will offer small, medium and large compartments, chosen at reservation.

## Knock-on changes

None. Grepped docs/ for "compartment size"; no document specifies one.

## Amendment (2026-04-12)

The locker measures the parcel at fill time; see the banner.
